articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Crypto exchanges tout cold storage ratios after Binance attack
articles.description: Coinbase says it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline, while Gate reports 88.26% of its total assets are kept in cold storage.

articles.title: Core Scientific to quit Bitcoin mining by year-end as AI business surges
articles.description: The former Bitcoin mining heavyweight plans to become a pure-play data center provider in 2027, with mining now accounting for just 7.5% of quarterly revenue.

articles.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
articles.description: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

articles.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
articles.description: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

articles.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
articles.description: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

articles.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
articles.description: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

articles.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
articles.description: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

articles.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
articles.description: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

articles.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
articles.description: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

articles.title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains
articles.description: Bitcoin saw sudden downside at the Wall Street open as stocks witnessed a snap sell-off, reversing post-election gains.

articles.title: Blockchain is ‘perfect solution’ for AI agent trust, VeChain CEO says
articles.description: Sunny Lu said AI agents would need identity and reputation systems, making the case while promoting agent-building platform VeWorld.ai.

articles.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
articles.description: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure — but skeptics have their doubts.

articles.title: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
articles.description: The SkyBridge founder said disputes over ethics restrictions also stalled negotiations, with both sides responsible for the setback.

articles.title: Thailand to block Bitget in December over unlicensed crypto trading
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, with access to its website and app set to be blocked from Dec. 5.

articles.title: Bitcoin win rate vs. S&P 500 recovers as post-midterm history favors stocks
articles.description: Bitcoin outperformed the S&P 500 in half of the past 90 US trading sessions, while historical midterm data highlights gains for stocks.

articles.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
articles.description: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.

articles.title: France budget rejection sidelines stablecoin tax, wallet reporting
articles.description: Three adopted amendments, including stablecoin taxation and self-custody reporting, fall away but could be reintroduced in the Senate.

articles.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs draw $128M as crypto rebounds after midterms
articles.description: Fidelity led Bitcoin ETF inflows, while BlackRock’s IBIT shed another $201 million, extending its outflow streak to four trading sessions.

articles.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
articles.description: The bank said customer funds were unaffected after attackers accessed its systems through a service provider’s platform.

articles.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
articles.description: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

articles.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
articles.description: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.

articles.title: India warns AI-powered hackers targeting crypto exchanges at ‘machine speed’
articles.description: India’s cybersecurity agency says a threat actor is escalating an AI-assisted hacking campaign targeting crypto exchanges and other financial firms.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
articles.description: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.

articles.title: BitMart founder says security team ‘severely understaffed’ after new hack
articles.description: The crypto exchange’s founder warned of security staffing shortages amid restructuring as analysts flagged suspicious transfers potentially linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack.

articles.title: Crypto PACs eye 2028 ‘new map’ as Democrats take Congress
articles.description: Crypto super PACs spent more than $176 million on the midterms, but the Democratic sweep raises the prospect of tougher industry scrutiny.

articles.title: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike
articles.description: From setting up an SMSF or a company, to just leaving the country entirely, here are some strategies Australian Bitcoiners can employ to deal with 2027’s massive CGT hike.

articles.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
articles.description: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.

articles.title: Riot shares surge on $28B AI lease as Hut 8 sinks on revenue miss
articles.description: Bitcoin miner Riot sold BTC to finance its AI expansion, while Hut 8 reported falling revenue and rising costs before its major data center leases generate income.

articles.title: Circle’s ARC token sale lifts earnings as lower yields weigh on USDC income
articles.description: Circle is looking to payments fees and future staking rewards to diversify revenue as its core stablecoin business faces pressure from lower yields and growing competition.
